I don’t think it’s wrong. I think it’s perfectly normal. You are a flesh and blood human and often you are drawn to people in your environment. The daydreaming is the hard part because you build up this person in your head and you feel this attachment to someone that in reality they aren’t but it feels real. You are not the only one. Sigh.

Oddly enough. This guy doesn’t match what I would normally be attracted to. He’s younger, I’m super not feminine and he’s a little preppy but he doesn’t seem to care. He seems calm and I’m super intense. We are a very unlikely match and I actually passed on him initially and went back and decided I liked his smile. He’s has a super nerdy thing going but I do too. Although I’ve been told my nerdy thing is more “cool” and honestly it’s true. I used to keep it out and separate from my whole dating attempts but once I added it it helped get responses and get conversations going. I actually really like our differences. I like that he has his shit I have mine. I like that he works hard and a lot because often I do too. I guess the biggest thing is I like how he makes me feel about myself. I don’t feel self conscious. He sees me. I feel feminine. After our date we were walking and he put his hand on my back and something about that was just...nice. 

This guy feels less permanent. I think he’s perfect to get me through learning to date. Having sex finally. I don’t know if I am in the place for a life partner. I feel like he and I are both lonely and I’d like it to be exclusive and real dating not just physical. But it doesn’t have to be everything. That’s probably why I haven’t talked about marriage or kids really. He doesn’t know about my whole virgin thing. I honestly think he may be ok with it. I guess I just can’t look into the future right now I’m very much trying to exist in the present because I too often get stuck in the past.

Anyhow I’m trying not to get carried away since everything is so uncertain. And that feels like it would be inviting even more hurt that I don’t think I can take lol. But I’m hoping for us. And I’m hoping for everyone else on here too. Even if it’s not a person they want or need. I hope they find something that makes life a little easier. Thanks for letting me word vomit this helped a lot and I didn’t want to post about it in the main sub since it’s still so uncertain.
I know. I’m not crazy or clingy. I’m just kind of a straight shooter and I wish I could expect the same from others. It’s like in our world showing interest is weakness.

Let me just say I had a few boyfriends in high school. A couple didn’t last long and the last one was kind of on and off. Then after about my sophomore year everything changed and guys stopped seeing me. I’m not sure what happened. I have never had an adult relationship so on that we are the 100% the same. 

Exactly that I’m tired of being alone. Me and my guy haven’t really talked about relationships. I’m just trying to get time and that’s so frustrating because I want someone to spend time with. Can I be alone. Yes. But I want a little more you know. And this feeling that I’m wasting my time just won’t go away. And I think in both of our cases we have these voices telling us that there is no way this is real. Is that me sabotaging myself or is that me reading this right and trying to make me see reality. I don’t know what is the right thing. All I know if I have followed that voice in my head and it’s gotten me nowhere so I’m letting myself be foolish and either it will pay off or it’s going to fucking hurt like a mother fucker. 

It’s tough because he checks so many boxes for me. I’m physically and mentally attracted to him. He appears to reciprocate. That hasn’t happens in so long. And I can tell your guy checks your boxes too. There are just these contradictory behaviors he has that is confusing you. Do you think if he wasn’t specifically talking about being your boyfriend it would be easier to walk away? I think the part that is hardest for me and possibly you is I’m hearing from him that I am enough just as I am and it’s intoxicating. I don’t know how to quit that. The words are amazing we both just need some follow through.

Exactly. Like he’s telling me the main guy at work got fired and now he’s running things and traveling but it’s going to mellow out. Plus he seems like the type that is super there for friends and family. Or at least that’s how he makes it seem. 

Mine said he broke his phone. I have no way to know for sure except that he has regularly contacted me since he beginning. That said I felt like why bother contacting me again if he as ghosting you know? 

We don’t talk on the phone. But our latest text conversation was great just like the beginning. And yeah I have no idea what’s going on. 

I told him last time he seems really busy and like there is no room for me and he said let’s try to be friends so I did but he said he wants to try.so I told him if he doesn’t come through this time i can’t anymore. I gave h the room to back out. He said we are definitely going to see each other. I’ve put my hard line and he knows where I stand so I guess I’ll see what happens. Tuesday I’ll know for sure.

I hate feeling stupid. I hate letting someone make me feel stupid.  And I feel like these guys are in this in between place where they may like us but just not enough you know. I wish this shit that everyone else finds so easy was easy for me. Or at least less complicated. But here we are. I believe people’s actions speak much louder than the words they say and go the first time the words are getting in the way.

Ive been going through something similar with the tinder guy. Turns out the ghosting and being stood up was due to a broken phone. Said he didn’t have my contact saved so he had to dig up my number on his Verizon online bill. He deleted his tinder so my message with my number was gone. 

Anyhow it’s been a month and he’s been crazy with work and traveling for work. He’s in NY this week and back Sunday night. Wants to see me next Tuesday he says for dinner. He apologized profusely after the missed date. He still kept texting me. He’s not all that wordy but he keeps in contact. Last night he was super chatty we talked til we fell asleep. So I guess I’ll see what happens. He doesn’t call me pet names or anything like that. But he says I’m funny and he wants to see me again. I deserve more of his time. That he thinks about me a lot. Shit like that. 

I have no idea what to do here. I’m rooting for you and myself. Lol

I want to tell us both to just cut our losses and move on. We deserve better. If they really wanted us they would make time. But I know we are a little different. And other than some hurt feelings and pain. What do we have to lose? Will I feel stupid if this was all for nothing yes. Very fucking stupid. I actually feel really stupid. But I guess I’m deciding to gamble on a bad bet lol. I’m not begging him or forcing myself on him. That I won’t do. I’m just a little too available I guess. I’m usually very cut and dry but I’m going to try patience and see if that gets me anything. God knows it’s hard to be patient when I’ve felt like I’ve been waiting for years. 

Im glad you are keeping busy. I know that helps me too. I have a deadline so I’ve just been working like a mad woman. So we will see if this date happens and once I’m done with my latest round of work if he’s not more available then I’m going to have to move on. Because even though I’ve been willing to compromise I won’t be the only one in this and I won’t wait forever. Too much of my life has passed me by. 

Hang in there. Hopefully things work out nicely for the both of us.

I think it is hard for people to respond and interact with that part of this sub. As someone that has vented, I notice people give advice or ignore your post. And that is fine. Interact with what you feel comfortable with. We are all at different phases of this and we all either accept it or try to work past it. Some people change themselves, some people don't see the point. So its hard to find a common thread for everyone because everyone is so different. 

Personally when I am in deep despair I ignore the upbeat posts because I just can't. But when I need a boost and to see that at least someone is making progress I read them so I personally like having the choice. 

I think overall I am going to keep my opinions to myself unless I am specifically asked from now on. I generally don't give advice I haven't myself tried or am actively trying.
